protocol.counterbalancing: Every unit contains AB and BA passes; no aggregate-only proxy substitutes for pairing.
protocol.eligibility: Exact answer pairs with both A/B and B/A passes present.
protocol.failure_handling: Unknown/invalid/provider failures are counted and cannot become flips.
protocol.hypothesis: Matched original/swap presentations quantify position sensitivity under tested conditions.
protocol.interpretation_limit: Paired disagreement indicates position sensitivity, not automatic causal position bias.
protocol.research_question: Does swapping Answer A and Answer B change the mapped decision?
protocol.tie_handling: Tie-in-one, tie-in-both, and decisive-vs-tie remain distinct states.
protocol.unit_definition: One pair/judge/configuration with two independently persisted presentation passes.
